item.title: Operation Epic Fury: US claims major strikes on Iran; Signals control over Iranian airspace
item.description: The White House announced that the United States is making significant progress in its military campaign against Iran under Operation Epic Fury. Press Secretary Karoline Leavitt said the operation aims to dismantle Iran’s ballistic missile capability, weaken its navy and prevent it from developing nuclear weapons.

item.title: Congress announces Singhvi, Vem Narender Reddy as candidates for Telangana Rajya Sabha Polls
item.description: The Congress party has nominated senior advocate Abhishek Manu Singhvi and former MLA Vem Narender Reddy for the upcoming Rajya Sabha elections from Telangana.

item.title: Rajya Sabha Elections 2026: Congress announces candidates from 6 states; Here’s the list
item.description: With the last date for filing nominations for the Rajya Sabha Elections 2026 ending today, the Congress party has announced its candidates from six states.

item.title: T20 World Cup 2026: Clear skies or rain? Mumbai weather in focus for IND vs ENG Semi-Final
item.description: India will face England in the second semi-final of the T20 World Cup 2026 at Mumbai’s Wankhede Stadium on March 5. The winner will advance to the final to take on New Zealand, who defeated South Africa in the first semi-final.

item.title: Sensex jumps 414 points; Nifty opens higher amid positive global cues
item.description: Indian benchmark indices opened higher on March 5, 2026, supported by positive global cues and strong buying interest. The BSE Sensex surged 414 points to 79,530, while the Nifty climbed above 24,600 in early trade.

item.title: Gold surges to Rs 1.62 lakh on MCX; Silver jumps nearly 2% amid global tensions
item.description: Gold and silver prices opened higher on the MCX as geopolitical tensions and a stronger dollar boosted safe-haven demand. Gold rose to ₹1.62 lakh per 10 grams while silver surged nearly 2% to ₹2.70 lakh per kilogram.

item.title: West Asia Crisis: Canada PM Mark Carney says military involvement cannot be ruled out
item.description: Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney said on Thursday that Canada cannot entirely rule out military involvement in the escalating West Asia conflict involving the US and Israel against Iran.

item.title: JD(U) workers stage protest at CM residence over Nitish Kumar’s Rajya Sabha move
item.description: Janata Dal (United) workers on Thursday staged protest at the residence of Bihar Chief Minister Nitish Kumar over his decision to file nomination for Rajya Sabha elections.

item.title: Nitish Kumar signals desire to join Rajya Sabha; Sparks political buzz in Bihar
item.description: Bihar Chief Minister Nitish Kumar has expressed his desire to become a Rajya Sabha member, fueling speculation about a possible Delhi move. In a social media post, he thanked citizens for over two decades of support and reaffirmed his commitment to Bihar’s development.

item.title: Farooq Abdullah slams US-led strikes on Iran; Urges Centre to clarify stand
item.description: Former Jammu and Kashmir Chief Minister and National Conference President Farooq Abdullah on Thursday slammed the Central Government over not showing any reaction on US-led strike on an independent nation.
